summary: After exact quadratic decoupling, each original-coordinate unnormalized ambiguity kernel has a universal L^p(R^2) budget <=pi for every p>=2. However, for any symmetric physical 3x3 block B, the three rank-two maps u -> (u_j,t(Bu)_j) have kernel directions n1=(0,-b13,b12), n2=(b23,0,-b12), n3=(-b23,b13,0), so n1+n2+n3=0 and the three-map codimension-one Brascamp-Lieb constant is infinite. Breaking symmetry gives a cycle determinant but only |t|^-3/2 on |phi|^2, hence |t|^-3/4 after square root, still nonintegrable. Full QFORM is not refuted.
